memory.note: 580 MB is a target, not a verified size. Packed 1.58-bit weights alone consume about 562.9 MB at 2.85B parameters, before scales, embeddings metadata, tokenizer, and runtime. The accompanying architecture report estimates 0.68-0.75 GB.

training.shard_strategy: one domain/expert adapter shard per runner; shared-backbone updates require a separate coordinated stage

parameter_budget_estimate.note: Exact PyTorch meta-device module count; raw 1.58-bit arithmetic only, excluding scales, tokenizer, alignment and runtime. Architecture code is a reference implementation; W1.58A8 packing is not yet implemented.
